wiki_article:
**A Body Prepared — Homunculus** is a work of creative prose by Rebekah Cranes with Lee Sharks, deposited 17 April 2026 as **EA-ARK-FICTION-01.1**.

It is the compressed companion to *A Body Prepared* (EA-ARK-FICTION-01), and the pairing is the point: the archive's compression theory holds that a work and its compression are distinct objects, so a compressed companion is deposited as its own record rather than folded into the parent as a summary. The homunculus — a body prepared, assembled rather than born — is an apt figure for a text that stands in a made relation to another text.

The work belongs to the Shark Ark fiction series at hex address `06.SEI.ARK.FICTION.01.1`, and is attributed to Rebekah Cranes **for the Dodecad**, a formulation that marks the voice as acting within the twelve-voice system rather than independently of it.
